entries.summary: You can now mark one favorite as Home with a house icon. The app starts there instead of your last location. Tap the house again to go back to the last location.
You can now turn individual place-search services on or off in Settings > Menus. Mainland China users can switch off Nominatim to avoid waiting for its timeout.
The hot locations list now updates online, so places can be added or removed without an app update.
The hot routes list now updates online, so routes can be added or removed without an app update.
Followers now walk at the leader's speed instead of their own. While the leader stands still, they use their own speed to catch up.
Place search now tries a second service when the first one fails. A service that has just failed is skipped for ten minutes.
You can now pick an app to open after the app handles a map link. Set it in Settings > Menus > Capture. It opens after you teleport or walk to the link's point.
Controls now show their state by color. They are grey when idle, green when moving, and orange when a walk, route, or roam is paused.
Switching the map style now takes effect on every map screen right away, without closing and reopening the screen.
The cooldown message and its badge now show in the app's supported languages instead of only English.
